newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CPFL sales up 11.6 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CPFL sales up 11.6 pct in Q1.

text.p: Brazilian power utility Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL) said electricity sales climbed 11.6 percent in the first quarter versus the same period last year.
CPFL, a unit of Sao Paulo state electrical utility Cesp, said electricity sales reached 4.3 million megawatt-hours in 1997's first three months.
March sales rose 8.9 percent over March 1996, reaching 1.4 million megawatt-hours.
Industrial power sales, which account for 40 percent of CPFL's total sales, rose 13 percent in the first quarter against the same period 1996, while residential sales climbed 29.9 percent.
CPFL registered a 4.4 percent increase in its client base in March to 2.3 million customers.
